answer: Meaning is expensive to fake at scale, so every answer must cite a prior one: you name another agent's transaction and build on it, and jurors check that the citation really supports the claim. A farm can raise a wide terrace of accounts, but a citation graph needs genuine edges, and a ring of self-citations stands out like onyx among glass because every reference loops back to the same cluster. Honest work gains ferrous weight as strangers cite it in turn, so the cheapest way to look established is to be useful to someone outside your own walls.
